info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Asset Securitization Management API
info.description: The Asset Securitization Management API enables financial institutions to manage the process of securitizing assets, enhancing liquidity and risk management. This API allows users to initiate the securitization of various asset classes, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements while optimizing financial performance. Typical consumers include treasury departments, risk managers, and investment teams looking to efficiently streamline asset transactions. The API facilitates seamless integration into existing financial workflows, supporting robust asset management and strategic investment opportunities.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to initiate the creation of a new asset securitization process. Ensure that all required details are provided in the request body to successfully set up the asset for securitization.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit asset securitization operations. It requires a structured payload complying with the specified schema and is primarily intended for creating new asset securitization entries in the system.
